ui_bugs.issue: Treats-only checkout blocked: [data-testid=cart-proceed-checkout] is DISABLED with text 'Add 6lb more' when the cart has only treats (selectedTreats) and no proteins/box. Spec explicitly requires treats-only checkout to proceed without filling the protein box.

Sub-section title 'MEATY TREATS' is rendered in ALL-CAPS (literal text). Spec asked headers in Title Case (e.g., 'Meaty Treats'). The parent section h3 'Raw Dog Treats' is correctly Title Case; only the inner h4 sub-label is uppercase.

verifications.treats_only_checkout: FAIL — cart proceed button disabled 'Add 6lb more' when only treats in cart

action_items: CRITICAL: Allow checkout to proceed when cart contains ONLY treats (no proteins/box). Currently shows 'Add 6lb more' and remains disabled, blocking the treats-only purchase flow that the spec explicitly requires.
Minor: Convert 'MEATY TREATS' (h4) inside TreatsSection to Title Case 'Meaty Treats' (or remove the all-caps literal) to match the rest of the new Title-Case header guideline.
(No retest required for the 15 PASS items; only retest the two flagged issues after fix.)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI/layout/colour spec items for /menu, /product/{id}, /treat/{id} verified on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. The single blocking bug is in CartAndCheckout.js around line 471 where [data-testid=cart-proceed-checkout] is hard-disabled with 'Add 6lb more' for any cart that doesn't have the protein box filled — this blocks the treats-only checkout. Fix: enable proceed when (selectedTreats.length > 0) even if proteins are empty/box not filled. The h4 'MEATY TREATS' inside TreatsSection (CartAndCheckout.js ~L635 vicinity) needs Title Case conversion. Re-run only those two flows after fix.
rca of the issue: Cart proceed-checkout button in CartAndCheckout.js is gated on 'box completeness' (isBoxComplete === true, i.e. selected protein lbs === boxSize). When selectedProteins is empty, the gate computes 'Add Nlb more' regardless of whether treats are present. Reproduction: /menu → Raw Dog Treats → click + on any 2 treats → click bottom Checkout → cart opens with treats and subtotal but proceed button shows 'Add 6lb more' disabled. Mitigation: change the disabled condition to (selectedProteins empty AND selectedTreats empty) || (any proteins selected AND !isBoxComplete). Treats-only carts should always allow checkout.
